award_rule: W requires valid accepted execution; U requires separate independent durable-advance adjudication; neither is automatic from this catalog.
claim_ceiling: Candidate task families only; no assignment, completed run, W/U issue or Product adoption.

tasks.candidate_deliverable: Role/task map and rival construct hypotheses
tasks.u_durable_advance_test: An independently checked map changes the case/construct decision
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: A frozen role, independent SME evidence and a falsifiable task-to-case link

tasks.candidate_deliverable: Versioned case variant, prior/exposure check and solution paths
tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A controlled contrast finds a useful case-family repair beyond a surface rewrite
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Independent reviewers verify answerability, alternatives, access and mechanism difference

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A matched control reduces a predeclared scorer error without new false rejection, or decisively rejects the repair at a bounded scope
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Blind ratings preserve valid alternatives, NA/UNK and transcript uncertainty

tasks.candidate_deliverable: Crossed case/rater/mode variance design and analysis
tasks.u_durable_advance_test: The result resolves whether an exact score/use scope is supportable
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: A registered design estimates uncertainty for one case per session

tasks.candidate_deliverable: Session 1 to unseen creative work comparison
tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A controlled transfer result changes the Session 1 claim or case policy
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Blind independent work criterion and exposure/fluency rivals

tasks.candidate_deliverable: Session 2 to unseen design work comparison
tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A controlled transfer result changes the Session 2 claim or rubric
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Blind design artifact and equal-time comparator

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A controlled result changes the Session 3 claim or case/rubric
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Partner-dependent behavior rather than narrative alone

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A bounded outcome finding changes the Product selection claim
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Frozen capacity, independent outcomes, two comparators and missingness rule

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A reproducible repair reduces a defined access or scoring error
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Predeclared mode, source and correction checks; human conclusions held

tasks.candidate_deliverable: Journey/feedback/cost comparison with explicit payer hypothesis
tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A controlled result changes feedback, service scope or Product posture
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: A measured outcome uses exact cohort, burden and cost denominators

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A tested rule changes interpretation without penalizing valid human answers
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Human false positives and family/mode holdouts are explicit

tasks.candidate_deliverable: Synthetic answer/scorer challenger against human-only baseline
tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A controlled error reduction changes a scorer-development choice
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: No human-validity claim without untouched human answer holdout

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A controlled contrast changes Session 3 case or rubric policy
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Observed coordination remains separate from social-script fluency

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: Executed decision value improves at matched source/review cost
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Reviewer arm leakage is controlled or interpretation is explicitly unblinded

tasks.u_durable_advance_test: A simulator improves a named case/scorer decision beyond a simpler rival
tasks.w_valid_execution_gate: Human alignment waits for permissioned untouched person/case/time holdout
